column1: # OpenVerify nickname table, authored rows (plan C58.3). Our own list, written from general
# knowledge of naming customs for this project; nothing here is copied from a compiled nickname
# list (decision 32: no CAAGRI or TNGenWeb page, no carltonnorthern names.csv).
# Columns, tab-separated: formal name, language (ISO 639-1), its nicknames (comma-separated).
# A row states only direct pairs (nickname <-> formal name); the matcher never chains them.
# packages/checks/scripts/build-nicknames.ts merges this file with the reviewed Wikidata pairs
# (nicknames-wikidata.tsv) into nicknames.json; edit these files, never the JSON.
